# Notation System Usage

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:NotationSystemUsage`](gmeow-NotationSystemUsage.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/NotationSystemUsage>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/notation`](../../slices/notation.md)

A reified, role- and period-scoped use of a notation system by an entity — an observation in the universal claim stack: the [gufo:Relator](../../external/terms.md#gufo-relator) binding {entity} × {notation system} × {role} × {period}, mirroring names' [`NameUsage`](gmeow-NameUsage.md) and languages' [`WritingSystemUsage`](gmeow-WritingSystemUsage.md). Lets a language use IPA for phonetic transcription, a musical work use Western staff notation, or a text use Morse code for encoding, each co-equally and standpoint-scoped.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:Observation`](gmeow-Observation.md), [`gufo:Relator`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-relator)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:NotationSystemUsage`](gmeow-NotationSystemUsage.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:Observation`](gmeow-Observation.md), [`gufo:Relator`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-relator). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.
